description: 索引的 fillfactor 是一个百分比，决定索引方法尝试将索引页填充到多满。对于 B-tree，首次构建索引和从右侧扩展索引（添加新的最大键值）时，叶页会填充到该比例。页面之后若完全填满，就会分裂，使索引效率逐渐降低。B-tree 的默认 fillfactor 为 90，可选择 10 到 100 之间的任意整数。如果表是静态的，使用 100 最有利于缩小索引的物理大小；频繁更新的表则适合较小的 fillfactor，以减少页面分裂。其他索引方法使用 fillfactor 的方式不同，但大致类似；默认值因方法而异。
storage_options.name: fillfactor

items.name: GIN
items.summary: GIN 索引是 “ 倒排索引 ” ，适用于包含多个组成值的数据值，例如数组。倒排索引会为每个组成值保存单独的项，因此能够高效处理测试特定组成值是否存在的查询。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 10.23 · indexes-ordering
evidence.quote: In addition to simply finding the rows to be returned by a query, an index may be able to deliver them in a specific sorted order. This allows a query's ORDER BY specification to be honored without a separate sorting step. Of the index types currently supported by PostgreSQL , only B-tree can produce sorted output — the other index types return matching rows in an unspecified, implementation-dependent order.

capabilities.label: 有序输出
capabilities.note: 普通的有序输出与按运算符排序是不同能力，例如按近邻距离排序。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 10.23 · indexes-unique
evidence.quote: Currently, only B-tree indexes can be declared unique.

capabilities.label: 唯一键
capabilities.note: 这里指唯一索引，排除约束采用不同的约定。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 10.23 · indexes-multicolumn
evidence.quote: Currently, only the B-tree, GiST, GIN, and BRIN index types support multicolumn indexes. Up to 32 columns can be specified. (This limit can be altered when building PostgreSQL ; see the file pg_config_manual.h .)

capabilities.label: 多键列
capabilities.note: 多个检索键与不参与检索的 INCLUDE 附加列是不同概念。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 10.23 · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: The complete CREATE INDEX synopsis has no INCLUDE clause in this manual build.

capabilities.label: INCLUDE 附加列
capabilities.note: 附加列不会成为检索键。过宽的附加数据可能超过索引元组大小限制。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 10.23 · indexes-index-only-scans
evidence.quote: The index type must support index-only scans. B-tree indexes always do. GiST and SP-GiST indexes support index-only scans for some operator classes but not others. Other index types have no support. The underlying requirement is that the index must physically store, or else be able to reconstruct, the original data value for each index entry. As a counterexample, GIN indexes cannot support index-only scans because each index entry typically holds only part of the original data value.

capabilities.label: 仅索引扫描
capabilities.note: 查询必须使用索引覆盖的值；能否避免访问堆取决于可见性映射状态。

capabilities.label: 按距离排序
capabilities.note: 可用性取决于所选操作符类和排序运算符。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 10.23 · parallel-plans
evidence.quote: In a parallel index scan or parallel index-only scan , the cooperating processes take turns reading data from the index. Currently, parallel index scans are supported only for btree indexes. Each process will claim a single index block and will scan and return all tuples referenced by that block; other processes can at the same time be returning tuples from a different index block. The results of a parallel btree scan are returned in sorted order within each worker process.

capabilities.label: 并行索引扫描
capabilities.note: 多个进程协作扫描同一索引，不同于并行位图堆扫描，也不同于 Parallel Append 下各自独立的串行扫描。

capabilities.label: 并行构建索引
capabilities.note: 并行构建与并行扫描分别记录，还取决于工作进程是否可用、配置和构建阶段。

（这些操作符的含义见 第 9.18 节 。）标准发布版自带的 GIN 操作符类记录在 表 66.1 中。还有许多其他 GIN 操作符类可在 contrib 集合或独立项目中获得。更多信息见 第 66 章 。

12.signature: CREATE INDEX name ON table_name USING gin (column_name);

description: 此设置控制 第 66.4.1 节 中描述的快速更新技术的使用。这是一个布尔参数： ON 启用快速更新， OFF 禁用快速更新。（如 第 19.1 节 中所述，允许使用 ON 和 OFF 的其他拼写形式。）默认值为 ON 。
通过 ALTER INDEX 关闭 fastupdate 后，新插入的条目不会再进入待处理索引条目列表，但此操作本身不会清理之前的条目。之后可对表执行 VACUUM 或调用 gin_clean_pending_list 函数，以确保待处理列表清空。
storage_options.name: fastupdate

description: 自定义 gin_pending_list_limit 参数。该值以千字节为单位。
storage_options.name: gin_pending_list_limit

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 13.23 · indexes-ordering
evidence.quote: In addition to simply finding the rows to be returned by a query, an index may be able to deliver them in a specific sorted order. This allows a query's ORDER BY specification to be honored without a separate sorting step. Of the index types currently supported by PostgreSQL , only B-tree can produce sorted output — the other index types return matching rows in an unspecified, implementation-dependent order.

capabilities.label: 有序输出
capabilities.note: 普通的有序输出与按运算符排序是不同能力，例如按近邻距离排序。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 13.23 · indexes-unique
evidence.quote: Currently, only B-tree indexes can be declared unique.

capabilities.label: 唯一键
capabilities.note: 这里指唯一索引，排除约束采用不同的约定。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 13.23 · indexes-multicolumn
evidence.quote: Currently, only the B-tree, GiST, GIN, and BRIN index types support multicolumn indexes. Up to 32 columns can be specified. (This limit can be altered when building PostgreSQL ; see the file pg_config_manual.h .)

capabilities.label: 多键列
capabilities.note: 多个检索键与不参与检索的 INCLUDE 附加列是不同概念。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 13.23 · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: Currently, the B-tree and the GiST index access methods support this feature. In B-tree and the GiST indexes, the values of columns listed in the INCLUDE clause are included in leaf tuples which correspond to heap tuples, but are not included in upper-level index entries used for tree navigation.

capabilities.label: INCLUDE 附加列
capabilities.note: 附加列不会成为检索键。过宽的附加数据可能超过索引元组大小限制。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 13.23 · indexes-index-only-scans
evidence.quote: The index type must support index-only scans. B-tree indexes always do. GiST and SP-GiST indexes support index-only scans for some operator classes but not others. Other index types have no support. The underlying requirement is that the index must physically store, or else be able to reconstruct, the original data value for each index entry. As a counterexample, GIN indexes cannot support index-only scans because each index entry typically holds only part of the original data value.

capabilities.label: 仅索引扫描
capabilities.note: 查询必须使用索引覆盖的值；能否避免访问堆取决于可见性映射状态。

capabilities.label: 按距离排序
capabilities.note: 可用性取决于所选操作符类和排序运算符。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 13.23 · parallel-plans
evidence.quote: In a parallel index scan or parallel index-only scan , the cooperating processes take turns reading data from the index. Currently, parallel index scans are supported only for btree indexes. Each process will claim a single index block and will scan and return all tuples referenced by that block; other processes can at the same time be returning tuples from a different index block. The results of a parallel btree scan are returned in sorted order within each worker process.

capabilities.label: 并行索引扫描
capabilities.note: 多个进程协作扫描同一索引，不同于并行位图堆扫描，也不同于 Parallel Append 下各自独立的串行扫描。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 13.23 · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: PostgreSQL can build indexes while leveraging multiple CPUs in order to process the table rows faster. This feature is known as parallel index build . For index methods that support building indexes in parallel (currently, only B-tree), maintenance_work_mem specifies the maximum amount of memory that can be used by each index build operation as a whole, regardless of how many worker processes were started. Generally, a cost model automatically determines how many worker processes should be requested, if any.

capabilities.label: 并行构建索引
capabilities.note: 并行构建与并行扫描分别记录，还取决于工作进程是否可用、配置和构建阶段。

paragraphs: GIN 索引是 “ 倒排索引 ” ，适用于包含多个组成值的数据值，例如数组。倒排索引会为每个组成值保存单独的项，因此能够高效处理测试特定组成值是否存在的查询。
与 GiST 和 SP-GiST 一样，GIN 也能支持多种不同的用户定义索引策略，GIN 索引可使用哪些具体操作符同样取决于索引策略。例如， PostgreSQL 标准发布版中包含一个用于数组的 GIN 操作符类，它支持使用下列操作符的索引化查询：
（这些操作符的含义见 第 9.19 节 。）标准发布版自带的 GIN 操作符类记录在 表 70.1 中。还有许多其他 GIN 操作符类可在 contrib 集合或独立项目中获得。更多信息见 第 70 章 。

15.signature: CREATE INDEX name ON table_name USING gin (column_name);

description: 此设置控制 第 70.4.1 节 中描述的快速更新技术的使用。这是一个布尔参数： ON 启用快速更新， OFF 禁用快速更新。默认值为 ON 。
通过 ALTER INDEX 关闭 fastupdate 后，新插入的条目不会再进入待处理索引条目列表，但此操作本身不会清理之前的条目。之后可对表执行 VACUUM 或调用 gin_clean_pending_list 函数，以确保待处理列表清空。
storage_options.name: fastupdate

description: 自定义 gin_pending_list_limit 参数。该值以千字节为单位。
storage_options.name: gin_pending_list_limit

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 16.15 · indexes-ordering
evidence.quote: In addition to simply finding the rows to be returned by a query, an index may be able to deliver them in a specific sorted order. This allows a query's ORDER BY specification to be honored without a separate sorting step. Of the index types currently supported by PostgreSQL , only B-tree can produce sorted output — the other index types return matching rows in an unspecified, implementation-dependent order.

capabilities.label: 有序输出
capabilities.note: 普通的有序输出与按运算符排序是不同能力，例如按近邻距离排序。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 16.15 · indexes-unique
evidence.quote: Currently, only B-tree indexes can be declared unique.

capabilities.label: 唯一键
capabilities.note: 这里指唯一索引，排除约束采用不同的约定。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 16.15 · indexes-multicolumn
evidence.quote: Currently, only the B-tree, GiST, GIN, and BRIN index types support multiple-key-column indexes. Whether there can be multiple key columns is independent of whether INCLUDE columns can be added to the index. Indexes can have up to 32 columns, including INCLUDE columns. (This limit can be altered when building PostgreSQL ; see the file pg_config_manual.h .)

capabilities.label: 多键列
capabilities.note: 多个检索键与不参与检索的 INCLUDE 附加列是不同概念。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 16.15 · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: Currently, the B-tree, GiST and SP-GiST index access methods support this feature. In these indexes, the values of columns listed in the INCLUDE clause are included in leaf tuples which correspond to heap tuples, but are not included in upper-level index entries used for tree navigation.

capabilities.label: INCLUDE 附加列
capabilities.note: 附加列不会成为检索键。过宽的附加数据可能超过索引元组大小限制。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 16.15 · indexes-index-only-scans
evidence.quote: The index type must support index-only scans. B-tree indexes always do. GiST and SP-GiST indexes support index-only scans for some operator classes but not others. Other index types have no support. The underlying requirement is that the index must physically store, or else be able to reconstruct, the original data value for each index entry. As a counterexample, GIN indexes cannot support index-only scans because each index entry typically holds only part of the original data value.

capabilities.label: 仅索引扫描
capabilities.note: 查询必须使用索引覆盖的值；能否避免访问堆取决于可见性映射状态。

capabilities.label: 按距离排序
capabilities.note: 可用性取决于所选操作符类和排序运算符。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 16.15 · parallel-plans
evidence.quote: In a parallel index scan or parallel index-only scan , the cooperating processes take turns reading data from the index. Currently, parallel index scans are supported only for btree indexes. Each process will claim a single index block and will scan and return all tuples referenced by that block; other processes can at the same time be returning tuples from a different index block. The results of a parallel btree scan are returned in sorted order within each worker process.

capabilities.label: 并行索引扫描
capabilities.note: 多个进程协作扫描同一索引，不同于并行位图堆扫描，也不同于 Parallel Append 下各自独立的串行扫描。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 16.15 · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: PostgreSQL can build indexes while leveraging multiple CPUs in order to process the table rows faster. This feature is known as parallel index build . For index methods that support building indexes in parallel (currently, only B-tree), maintenance_work_mem specifies the maximum amount of memory that can be used by each index build operation as a whole, regardless of how many worker processes were started. Generally, a cost model automatically determines how many worker processes should be requested, if any.

capabilities.label: 并行构建索引
capabilities.note: 并行构建与并行扫描分别记录，还取决于工作进程是否可用、配置和构建阶段。

paragraphs: GIN 索引是 “ 倒排索引 ” ，适用于包含多个组成值的数据值，例如数组。倒排索引会为每个组成值保存单独的项，因此能够高效处理测试特定组成值是否存在的查询。
与 GiST 和 SP-GiST 一样，GIN 也能支持多种不同的用户定义索引策略，GIN 索引可使用哪些具体操作符同样取决于索引策略。例如， PostgreSQL 标准发布版中包含一个用于数组的 GIN 操作符类，它支持使用下列操作符的索引化查询：
（这些操作符的含义见 第 9.19 节 。）标准发布版自带的 GIN 操作符类记录在 表 65.3 中。还有许多其他 GIN 操作符类可在 contrib 集合或独立项目中获得。更多信息见 第 65.4 节 。

18.signature: CREATE INDEX name ON table_name USING gin (column_name);

description: 控制 第 65.4.4.1 节 中描述的快速更新技术的使用。 ON 启用快速更新， OFF 禁用快速更新。默认值为 ON 。
通过 ALTER INDEX 关闭 fastupdate 后，新插入的条目不会再进入待处理索引条目列表，但此操作本身不会清理已有条目。之后可对表执行 VACUUM 或调用 gin_clean_pending_list 函数，以确保待处理列表清空。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 19beta4 · indexes-ordering
evidence.quote: In addition to simply finding the rows to be returned by a query, an index may be able to deliver them in a specific sorted order. This allows a query's ORDER BY specification to be honored without a separate sorting step. Of the index types currently supported by PostgreSQL , only B-tree can produce sorted output — the other index types return matching rows in an unspecified, implementation-dependent order.

capabilities.label: 有序输出
capabilities.note: 普通的有序输出与按运算符排序是不同能力，例如按近邻距离排序。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 19beta4 · indexes-unique
evidence.quote: Currently, only B-tree indexes can be declared unique.

capabilities.label: 唯一键
capabilities.note: 这里指唯一索引，排除约束采用不同的约定。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 19beta4 · indexes-multicolumn
evidence.quote: Currently, only the B-tree, GiST, GIN, and BRIN index types support multiple-key-column indexes. Whether there can be multiple key columns is independent of whether INCLUDE columns can be added to the index. Indexes can have up to 32 columns, including INCLUDE columns. (This limit can be altered when building PostgreSQL ; see the file pg_config_manual.h .)

capabilities.label: 多键列
capabilities.note: 多个检索键与不参与检索的 INCLUDE 附加列是不同概念。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 19beta4 · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: Currently, the B-tree, GiST and SP-GiST index access methods support this feature. In these indexes, the values of columns listed in the INCLUDE clause are included in leaf tuples which correspond to heap tuples, but are not included in upper-level index entries used for tree navigation.

capabilities.label: INCLUDE 附加列
capabilities.note: 附加列不会成为检索键。过宽的附加数据可能超过索引元组大小限制。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 19beta4 · indexes-index-only-scans
evidence.quote: The index type must support index-only scans. B-tree indexes always do. GiST and SP-GiST indexes support index-only scans for some operator classes but not others. Other index types have no support. The underlying requirement is that the index must physically store, or else be able to reconstruct, the original data value for each index entry. As a counterexample, GIN indexes cannot support index-only scans because each index entry typically holds only part of the original data value.

capabilities.label: 仅索引扫描
capabilities.note: 查询必须使用索引覆盖的值；能否避免访问堆取决于可见性映射状态。

capabilities.label: 按距离排序
capabilities.note: 可用性取决于所选操作符类和排序运算符。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 19beta4 · parallel-plans
evidence.quote: In a parallel index scan or parallel index-only scan , the cooperating processes take turns reading data from the index. Currently, parallel index scans are supported only for btree indexes. Each process will claim a single index block and will scan and return all tuples referenced by that block; other processes can at the same time be returning tuples from a different index block. The results of a parallel btree scan are returned in sorted order within each worker process.

capabilities.label: 并行索引扫描
capabilities.note: 多个进程协作扫描同一索引，不同于并行位图堆扫描，也不同于 Parallel Append 下各自独立的串行扫描。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 19beta4 · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: PostgreSQL can build indexes while leveraging multiple CPUs in order to process the table rows faster. This feature is known as parallel index build . For index methods that support building indexes in parallel (currently, B-tree, GIN, and BRIN), maintenance_work_mem specifies the maximum amount of memory that can be used by each index build operation as a whole, regardless of how many worker processes were started. Generally, a cost model automatically determines how many worker processes should be requested, if any.

capabilities.label: 并行构建索引
capabilities.note: 并行构建与并行扫描分别记录，还取决于工作进程是否可用、配置和构建阶段。

9.0.signature: CREATE INDEX name ON table_name USING gin (column_name);

description: 此设置控制 第 53.3.1 节 中描述的快速更新技术的使用。这是一个布尔参数： ON 启用快速更新， OFF 禁用快速更新。（如 第 18.1 节 中所述，允许使用 ON 和 OFF 的其他拼写形式。）默认值为 ON 。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 9.1.24 · indexes-ordering
evidence.quote: In addition to simply finding the rows to be returned by a query, an index may be able to deliver them in a specific sorted order. This allows a query's ORDER BY specification to be honored without a separate sorting step. Of the index types currently supported by PostgreSQL , only B-tree can produce sorted output — the other index types return matching rows in an unspecified, implementation-dependent order.

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 9.1.24 · indexes-unique
evidence.quote: Currently, only B-tree indexes can be declared unique.

capabilities.label: 唯一键

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 9.1.24 · indexes-multicolumn

capabilities.label: 唯一键
capabilities.note: 这里指唯一索引，排除约束采用不同的约定。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 11.22 · indexes-multicolumn

capabilities.label: 多键列

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 11.22 · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: Currently, only the B-tree index access method supports this feature. In B-tree indexes, the values of columns listed in the INCLUDE clause are included in leaf tuples which correspond to heap tuples, but are not included in upper-level index entries used for tree navigation.

capabilities.label: INCLUDE 附加列

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 11.22 · indexes-index-only-scans
evidence.quote: The index type must support index-only scans. B-tree indexes always do. GiST and SP-GiST indexes support index-only scans for some operator classes but not others. Other index types have no support. The underlying requirement is that the index must physically store, or else be able to reconstruct, the original data value for each index entry. As a counterexample, GIN indexes cannot support index-only scans because each index entry typically holds only part of the original data value.

capabilities.label: 仅索引扫描

capabilities.label: 按距离排序
capabilities.note: 可用性取决于所选操作符类和排序运算符。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 11.22 · parallel-plans
evidence.quote: In a parallel index scan or parallel index-only scan , the cooperating processes take turns reading data from the index. Currently, parallel index scans are supported only for btree indexes. Each process will claim a single index block and will scan and return all tuples referenced by that block; other processes can at the same time be returning tuples from a different index block. The results of a parallel btree scan are returned in sorted order within each worker process.

capabilities.label: 并行索引扫描
capabilities.note: 多个进程协作扫描同一索引，不同于并行位图堆扫描，也不同于 Parallel Append 下各自独立的串行扫描。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 11.22 · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: PostgreSQL can build indexes while leveraging multiple CPUs in order to process the table rows faster. This feature is known as parallel index build . For index methods that support building indexes in parallel (currently, only B-tree), maintenance_work_mem specifies the maximum amount of memory that can be used by each index build operation as a whole, regardless of how many worker processes were started. Generally, a cost model automatically determines how many worker processes should be requested, if any.

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 14.24 · parallel-plans
evidence.quote: In a parallel index scan or parallel index-only scan , the cooperating processes take turns reading data from the index. Currently, parallel index scans are supported only for btree indexes. Each process will claim a single index block and will scan and return all tuples referenced by that block; other processes can at the same time be returning tuples from a different index block. The results of a parallel btree scan are returned in sorted order within each worker process.

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 15.19 · indexes-ordering
evidence.quote: In addition to simply finding the rows to be returned by a query, an index may be able to deliver them in a specific sorted order. This allows a query's ORDER BY specification to be honored without a separate sorting step. Of the index types currently supported by PostgreSQL , only B-tree can produce sorted output — the other index types return matching rows in an unspecified, implementation-dependent order.

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 17.11 · indexes-index-only-scans
evidence.quote: The index type must support index-only scans. B-tree indexes always do. GiST and SP-GiST indexes support index-only scans for some operator classes but not others. Other index types have no support. The underlying requirement is that the index must physically store, or else be able to reconstruct, the original data value for each index entry. capabilities.label: 仅索引扫描

capabilities.label: 按距离排序
capabilities.note: 可用性取决于所选操作符类和排序运算符。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 17.11 · parallel-plans
evidence.quote: In a parallel index scan or parallel index-only scan , the cooperating processes take turns reading data from the index. Currently, parallel index scans are supported only for btree indexes. Each process will claim a single index block and will scan and return all tuples referenced by that block; other processes can at the same time be returning tuples from a different index block. The results of a parallel btree scan are returned in sorted order within each worker process.

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 17.11 · sql-createindex

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 20devel · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: Currently, the B-tree, GiST and SP-GiST index access methods support this feature. In these indexes, the values of columns listed in the INCLUDE clause are included in leaf tuples which correspond to heap tuples, but are not included in upper-level index entries used for tree navigation.

capabilities.label: INCLUDE 附加列
capabilities.note: 附加列不会成为检索键。过宽的附加数据可能超过索引元组大小限制。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 20devel · indexes-index-only-scans
evidence.quote: The index type must support index-only scans. B-tree indexes always do. GiST and SP-GiST indexes support index-only scans for some operator classes but not others. Other index types have no support. The underlying requirement is that the index must physically store, or else be able to reconstruct, the original data value for each index entry. As a counterexample, GIN indexes cannot support index-only scans because each index entry typically holds only part of the original data value.

capabilities.label: 仅索引扫描
capabilities.note: 查询必须使用索引覆盖的值；能否避免访问堆取决于可见性映射状态。

capabilities.label: 按距离排序
capabilities.note: 可用性取决于所选操作符类和排序运算符。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 20devel · parallel-plans
evidence.quote: In a parallel index scan or parallel index-only scan , the cooperating processes take turns reading data from the index. Currently, parallel index scans are supported only for btree indexes. Each process will claim a single index block and will scan and return all tuples referenced by that block; other processes can at the same time be returning tuples from a different index block. The results of a parallel btree scan are returned in sorted order within each worker process.

capabilities.label: 并行索引扫描
capabilities.note: 多个进程协作扫描同一索引，不同于并行位图堆扫描，也不同于 Parallel Append 下各自独立的串行扫描。

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 20devel · sql-createindex
evidence.quote: PostgreSQL can build indexes while leveraging multiple CPUs in order to process the table rows faster. This feature is known as parallel index build . For index methods that support building indexes in parallel (currently, B-tree, GIN, and BRIN), maintenance_work_mem specifies the maximum amount of memory that can be used by each index build operation as a whole, regardless of how many worker processes were started. Generally, a cost model automatically determines how many worker processes should be requested, if any.

capabilities.note: 并行构建与并行扫描分别记录，还取决于工作进程是否可用、配置和构建阶段。

original_text./summary: BRIN indexes (a shorthand for Block Range INdexes) store summaries about the values stored in consecutive physical block ranges of a table. For data types that have a linear sort order, the indexed data corresponds to the minimum and maximum values of the values in the column for each block range. This supports indexed queries using these operators:

evidence.label: PostgreSQL 9.5.25 · indexes-ordering
evidence.quote: In addition to simply finding the rows to be returned by a query, an index may be able to deliver them in a specific sorted order. This allows a query's ORDER BY specification to be honored without a separate sorting step. Of the index types currently supported by PostgreSQL , only B-tree can produce sorted output — the other index types return matching rows in an unspecified, implementation-dependent order.
